text:
Rae: opened a small PR to tidy the audit-export playbook and add minimal SDK examples + retention phrasing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/689
Priya: Thanks! Legal asked we avoid absolute retention claims. Use 'default retention period (for example, 90 days)' and call out contractual overrides.
Rae: Updated the language to: 'Default retention periods are guidance; enforceable periods are determined by customer contracts, compliance obligations, and applicable law, and may be overridden for Dedicated/Private deployments.'
Miguel: Can we include a tiny curl + node streaming snippet and a short Go example? Keep both < 8 lines each.
Rae: Yep. Added these two and put longer variants under 'Appendix: Extended examples'. Snippets are runnable-ish and show `redact:true` or `--redact` flags.
Priya: Legal asks to avoid implying guaranteed redaction. Reword to 'tools for pseudonymization/redaction are available' instead of 'we redact'.
Rae: Changed wording and added a pseudonymize helper example:
```
function pseudonymize(r){ return {...r, user_ref: hash(r.user_id)} }
```
Miguel: Small nit: in the JSON schema sample swap user_id -> user_ref so the example doesn't show raw IDs.
Rae: Done. Also fixed a broken internal link flagged by link-checker.
docs-bot: link-checker: found 1 broken link in docs/export-playbook.md -> https://internal.company/export-guidelines (404)
DevEx: pushed link fix to point at https://docs.redwood.com/export-playbook#guidelines in commit a7c4ef.
Priya: Quick final read from Legal done; left one punctuation suggestion.
Legal: Approved after tiny punctuation tweak. Also added suggestion: include a short sentence that customers on Dedicated can configure retention via the admin API.
Rae: Added note about Dedicated admin API and an illustrative curl example for TTL update.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/admin/tenants/acme/retention -d '{"ttl_days":180}'
```
Miguel: Approving once the streaming block has a language marker (```js).
Rae: Added the marker, ran docs CI locally, all green. Merged to main.
Priya: :white_check_mark:
Miguel: :shipit:
docs-bot: deploy-notice: docs.main updated (build 1345) - checks passed"
